question: Who among the following is known for playing the Mridangam?
solution:
The correct answer is __**RV Raghavan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **RV Raghavan** is a renowned Indian percussionist known for playing the **Mridangam**, a traditional South Indian drum.
 
• He is recognized for his contributions to **Carnatic music** and has performed globally, bringing the Mridangam to international audiences.
 
• Vinayakram has collaborated with various musicians across genres, highlighting his versatility and skill on the Mridangam.
 
• He has been awarded prestigious honors such as the **Padma Bhushan** and the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award** for his contributions to Indian classical music.
 
• He is also a key member of the world-famous ensemble **Shakti**, which fuses Indian classical music with jazz.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mridangam**

 
 
• The Mridangam is a double-headed drum, traditionally made from jackfruit wood and leather, used in South Indian classical music.
 
• It plays a crucial role in Carnatic music, providing rhythmic support and structure to compositions.
 
• The drum is played using fingers and palms, producing a variety of sounds and intricate rhythms.
 
• Mridangam players often undergo rigorous training and practice to master the complex techniques and rhythms.
 
 
 
• **Carnatic Music**
 
 
• Carnatic music is a system of music commonly associated with the southern part of India.
 
• It is one of the two main subgenres of Indian classical music that evolved from ancient Hindu traditions, the other being Hindustani music.
 
• Carnatic music emphasizes vocal performance, even in instrumental music, and is known for its intricate rhythms and improvisations.
 
 
 
• **Padma Bhushan**
 
 
• The Padma Bhushan is the third-highest civilian award in India, given for distinguished service of a high order in any field.
 
• It is awarded by the Government of India and recognizes exceptional talent and accomplishments.
 
 
 
• **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award**
 
 
• This award is the highest Indian recognition given to practicing artists for their outstanding contribution to the performing arts.
 
• It is awarded by the Sangeet Natak Akademi, India's national academy for music, dance, and drama.
